header.aboutDescription: EO4FUS is an application that provides users with a quick overview of forest conditions for a selected area in the part of Slovenia covered by the 2023 LiDAR survey. It combines data from airborne laser scanning (LiDAR 2023), Sentinel-2 satellite imagery, and field measurements to estimate selected metrics such as tree height, crown area, growing stock, and others. It was developed within a project fully funded by the European Space Agency (ESA), in collaboration between Flai, the Slovenian Forestry Institute (SFI), and the Research Centre of the Slovenian Academy of Sciences and Arts (ZRC SAZU).

results.disclaimer: Displayed metrics are based on 2023 data. Values are model estimates and may differ from actual field conditions. Pixels whose centre falls within the selected area are included.

results.uncertaintyNote: The error is relative: the model has a single absolute uncertainty across the whole area (± {agb} t/ha for biomass, ± {volume} m³/ha for growing stock), divided here by the prediction. The percentage therefore falls as the prediction rises, and is not a measure of this pixel's accuracy.
